title: The source note
body: At the bottom of the ledger: SOURCE OF TRUTH — DO NOT COPY. The warning is underlined in your handwriting.

choices.label: Take the LENS and file the note.

outcome.text: The basement files itself. A clean page remains where your name was. You carry the eye upstairs.

choices.label: Leave the LENS in the ledger.

outcome.text: The city can keep one eye closed. You cannot. The glass is in your pocket when you reach the stairs.
